question: Whether the applicant may use browser automation in their own account to submit ordinary event participation forms after discovering candidates with the official v2 API.
declared_fail_closed_behavior: Until explicit permission is received, the system sends candidate URLs to the applicant by Telegram and performs zero automated connpass participation submissions.
allowed_scope: Browser automation of ordinary event participation by the account owner, using the owner's own connpass account, when the purpose is not scraping.
conditions: wait at least 5 seconds between connpass accesses
do not submit on behalf of third parties
do not use for sales activity
avoid short-interval or bulk access to pages and APIs
do not bypass ordinary connpass flows or restrictions
